name: Sound Voyages VR
summary:
### Step inside the music.

Sound Voyages VR turns each piece of music into a place you can stand in. Pick a voyage and the world wraps around you in 360°: neon night drives, deep space, ocean abysses, ancient shrines, dance floors and storms. Every voyage is original music by iKRX, made for 360° video and streamed at full quality — up to 8K at 60 fps, without the compression of video sites.

### A new voyage every week
Over 120 immersive voyages already, and a new one every week. Collections: Serenity Vibe
